scope: Read-only source continuity audit against rc.5. SHA-256 compares git baseline blobs directly with working-tree bytes. Isolated PHP helper probes do not load a database, authentication, media or private configuration. Browser layout, SQL behavior, generated ZIP payloads and deployment are verified separately.

snapshot_changes.note: Other agents are completing version/docs/favicon/browser evidence concurrently. This report protects only the explicitly listed unchanged paths; it does not freeze the complete candidate diff.

brand_implementation_continuity.public_custom_logo_precedence: mark() calls image() for the published logo, or saved draft in authorized preview, and returns it before trying bundledMark(). mark(), image(), state(), save(), transition(), publicImage() and preview helpers are byte-identical to rc.5. No CMS state rewrite was added.
brand_implementation_continuity.admin_shared_shell: views/header.php deliberately uses bundledMark() so installer/login/admin identity does not require database-backed public brand selection.

legacy_logo_audit.audit_note: The retained legacy image files are not active defaults. Shared public header/footer/PJAX and admin/login/setup rendering select the approved sculpted artwork through Branding helpers. Favicon asset replacement is a separate authorized scope.

footer_and_shell_source_review.explanation: The final same-specificity .site-shell rule uses overflow: visible!important, overriding its earlier overflow-x: clip!important. The footer uses overflow: visible and an isolated positioned ::before extending by calc(50% - 50vw). Body horizontal clipping is at the viewport edge. The transparent shell has zero border, shadow, radius and outline; desktop 1px padding retains the former border layout space without a visible edge.

generated_hero_note: Wide runtime WebPs are generated in package staging, not stored in the source checkout. All tracked original hero/stage assets and both generators plus package.py are unchanged; exact generated ZIP asset comparison belongs to the final package continuity gate.

header_transparency_source_review.note: This separately authorized presentation edit changes only the backplate rgba alpha from .965 to .75. The header element retains a transparent background; no whole-element opacity is applied. Actual computed values and screenshot checks belong to the browser agent.
